integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Your hotel's connections with the outside world: payments, channels, DIAN, messaging and AI.

banner.title: {{count}} of {{total}} integrations in simulated mode
banner.allReal: Every integration runs in real mode
banner.body: While they are simulated nothing is charged, invoiced, reported or sent for real. Each integration has its step-by-step guide: the account to create, where each key is and how to test the connection.
banner.bodyReal: Charges, invoices, reports and messages go through your real providers.
banner.bodyUnfinished: They are already in real mode but their provider keys are missing: until they are complete Housetel does not use them. Follow each one's guide.
banner.tapHint: Tap an integration to see its guide.

mode.label: Mode
mode.unavailable: This mode has no provider yet

payments.title: Online payments
payments.description: Card, PSE and Nequi payments from the booking engine, the marketplace and payment links.
payments.simulated: A practice gateway approves, declines or expires payments without moving money.
payments.real: Wompi charges for real into your hotel's account.

channel_ical.title: iCal calendars
channel_ical.description: Syncs availability with Airbnb, VRBO or Booking.com through iCal calendars.
channel_ical.simulated: Only Housetel calendars are read, without going online.
channel_ical.real: Downloads your channels' calendars over HTTPS every 15 minutes.

channel_channex.title: Channex (OTAs)
channel_channex.description: Connects Booking.com, Expedia and 50+ channels through Channex.
channel_channex.simulated: The OTA simulator (BookSim and AirSim) receives your rates and creates test bookings.
channel_channex.real: Sends availability and rates to Channex and downloads its bookings.

einvoice.title: DIAN e-invoicing
einvoice.description: Issues your guests' invoices to DIAN through an authorized provider.
einvoice.simulated: Creates test invoices with CUFE and PDF, with no tax validity.
einvoice.real: Factus validates each invoice with DIAN.

sire.title: SIRE · Migración Colombia
sire.description: Reports the arrival and departure of foreign guests.
sire.simulated: Builds the upload file and a local receipt.
sire.real: Builds the file to upload to Migración Colombia's SIRE portal.

tra.title: TRA · MinCIT
tra.description: Registers each guest's hotel registration card (TRA) at check-in.
tra.simulated: Assigns a local TRA number without sending it to MinCIT.
tra.real: Sends each record to MinCIT's TRA service with your RNT token.

email.title: Email
email.description: Confirmations, payment links and guest lifecycle messages.
email.simulated: Emails stay in Housetel's inbox and are not sent.
email.real: Sent over SMTP: the platform's or your own domain's.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Messages to guests over WhatsApp Business (Meta's official API).
whatsapp.real: Sends and receives messages with your WhatsApp Business number.

llm.title: AI assistant
llm.description: The copilot, the guest chatbot, onboarding and daily briefs use an AI model.
llm.simulated: A local rule-based assistant answers: useful, but with no real intelligence.
llm.real: Gemini (or Claude) answers with the platform key or yours.

sheet.description: Choose the mode and, for real mode, the provider's credentials.
sheet.secretWillRemove: Will be removed when you save
sheet.secretHint: For security, secrets are never shown: they are only stored.
sheet.enabledHint: Turned off, Housetel won't use it even if it is configured.
sheet.neverTested: The connection hasn't been tested yet.
sheet.saveReal: Save and switch to real mode
sheet.realWarning: In real mode operations happen for real: charges, invoices, reports or messages.
sheet.saveBeforeTest: Save your changes to test them.
sheet.testUsesSaved: The test uses the saved configuration.

webhook.title: Events URL (webhook)
webhook.payments: Paste it in your Wompi dashboard › Developers › Transaction tracking › Events URL.
webhook.whatsapp: Paste it in Meta › WhatsApp › Configuration › Webhook, with the same text you type below in “Webhook verify token”.
webhook.local: This URL is local: the provider cannot call it from the internet. To test from your computer, open a public tunnel:
webhook.localThen: Copy the https://…trycloudflare.com address it shows, put it in PUBLIC_BASE_URL in the .env file and recreate backend, worker and beat (docker compose up -d backend worker beat): the URL above will use that address.

automations.title: Automations
automations.description: What Housetel does on its own, on time. Turn them on or pause the ones you don't use, tune their parameters or run them now.

rail.label: Schedule of {{name}}: {{schedule}}
rail.footnote: Times are the hotel’s ({{zone}}); the shaded band is the night (10 pm–6 am) and the dotted line is the current time.

toasts.queued: “{{name}}” was queued: you'll see the result in its history in a few minutes.

paramsDialog.title: Parameters of “{{name}}”
paramsDialog.description: They change how this automation works in this hotel.

paramLabels.ai_summary_once_a_day: AI summary only on the day's first scheduled run
paramLabels.retention_days: Days after check-out before deleting documents and signatures (0 = never)

historySheet.title: History of “{{name}}”
historySheet.description: Every run, who asked for it and how it went.

notice.title: Ran just now: {{status}}
notice.queued: It runs in the background: the result will show up under the last run and in the history in a few minutes.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what and when in your hotel. Reversible actions can be undone from here.
audit.organizationEventHint: Organization event (guests, team): visible in all of its hotels.

detail.title: Event details
detail.noChanges: This event keeps no before and after.
detail.undoEvent: View the action that undid it
detail.noPermission: You need the “Undo audited actions” permission to undo it.
detail.canUndo: It can be undone: Housetel will put the data back as it was before this action.

undoDialog.title: Undo this action?
undoDialog.description: Housetel will put the data back as it was before “{{summary}}”. The change is recorded in the audit log.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: What needs your attention. Each alert says what happened and where to fix it.
alerts.emptyOpenHint: There are no open alerts in this hotel.
alerts.emptyResolved: No alert has been resolved yet.

widget.title: Alerts
widget.allClear: All clear: there are no open alerts.

history.title: Reservation history
history.description: Every change to this reservation, its stays, its folio and its payments, with undo for what is reversible.
history.empty: No changes recorded for this reservation yet.

unguaranteed_arrival.message: {{guest}} arrives on {{checkin}} and booking {{code}} has no guarantee or payments. Ask for a deposit or confirm it by phone.

duplicate_payment.message: Two payments of {{amount}} with the same method ({{method}}) were recorded on {{target}} less than 10 minutes apart. Check whether one should be voided or refunded.

rate_out_of_bounds.message_other: {{count}} nights of {{roomType}} ({{ratePlan}}) have a price outside the limits or below 30% of the base price: {{prices}}. First date: {{first}}.

unposted_nights.message_other: {{guest}} ({{room}}) has {{count}} nights without a room charge after the night audit, since {{first}}.

vip_room_not_ready.message: {{guest}} (VIP) arrives around {{eta}} and room {{room}} is {{roomStatus}}. Prioritize its cleaning or move them to another room.

missing_invoice.title: Check-out without an invoice: {{code}}
missing_invoice.message: {{guest}} checked out more than an hour ago and the e-invoice for {{code}} has not been issued.

cash_difference.title: Cash difference of {{difference}}
cash_difference.message: {{user}}'s cash shift closed with a {{direction}} of {{difference}} (expected {{expected}}, counted {{counted}}).

oversold.message_one: {{roomType}} has more nights sold than units on {{count}} date (up to {{worst}} too many), {{first}}. Move or contact the guests.
oversold.message_other: {{roomType}} has more nights sold than units on {{count}} dates (up to {{worst}} too many), from {{first}}. Move or contact the guests.

daily_brief.title: Daily summary · {{date}}
daily_brief.alerts: - Open alerts: {{critical}} critical and {{warning}} to review.

llm_degraded.title: The AI is answering in simulated mode
llm_degraded.message: {{provider}} did not respond: {{error}}. Housetel keeps working with the simulated assistant until the provider is available again.

overbooking.message_other: Booking {{code}} was accepted with no free units on {{count}} nights. Move or reassign it before arrival.

overdue_departures.title_other: {{count}} guests were due to leave and are still in house

sire_unsubmitted.message_other: Download the files, upload them on the SIRE portal and mark them as reported.
